travelCategories.subtitle: The taxonomy a trip is planned against — shorter than the accounting one, with the editor block each category opens.

kindHelp.STANDARD: A typed amount, pre-filled from the per-diem for the destination and category when one applies.
kindHelp.AIRFARE: Searches flights for the trip’s dates and route, and records the one picked.
kindHelp.LODGING: Searches stays for the trip’s dates, capped at the per-diem lodging rate.
kindHelp.DEPARTMENT_MEAL: Captures attendees and how often the meal recurs, and computes the amount from the per-diem rate.
kindHelp.CAR_RENTAL: Priced from the daily cap × the days of the trip. No provider quotes car hire.
kindHelp.GROUND: Taxi, rideshare or transit, priced from a daily cap.

travelCategories.glAccountHelp: Optional. Set one only for a category with no expense counterpart to inherit from.
travelCategories.glAccountInheritsHelp: Leave blank to inherit the account from {category}.
travelCategories.reorderHint: Drag rows to set the order travellers see.

controlEvaluation.neverRun: No evaluation has been run yet.

controlEvaluation.runFailed: This evaluation failed and its findings are incomplete: {error}
controlEvaluation.controlsFailed: These controls could not be evaluated and are NOT reflected below: {controls}.

controlEvaluation.emptyClean: No deficiencies found in this evaluation.
controlEvaluation.thresholdHelp: Applies to the next evaluation, not to past runs.

why.STALE_DRAFT: Costs the company has incurred but not recorded. The period is understated until the draft is submitted or abandoned.
why.SUBMITTED_NO_ACTION: The employee did their part and the approval control did not operate. Delay here is what turns into a rush at close.
why.RETURN_WITHOUT_NOTE: The submitter is left guessing, and there is no record of why the company declined to record the cost.
why.APPROVED_WITHOUT_RECEIPT: An approved expense with no supporting document cannot be substantiated to an auditor or a tax authority.
why.FX_RATE_MISSING: Without a rate the reimbursement figure is either wrong or invented. This is a measurement failure, not paperwork.
why.GL_MAPPING_GAP: The category cannot be posted to the general ledger, so the export will either fail or land in a suspense account.
why.TRAVEL_WITHOUT_APPROVAL: The spend happened and the authorisation did not. A request filed after the trip is not pre-approval — it is a record of a decision nobody got to make.
why.TRAVEL_BUDGET_OVERRUN: The approval was for a number, and spend beyond it was never authorised by anyone. An overrun is often legitimate; going unnoticed is not.
